species.real: The stories that London's parakeets came from Jimi Hendrix or the set of The African Queen are myths; research suggests they come from many separate escapes and releases over decades.
species.name: Parakit

dex.text: Arrives in a loud green coat and makes sure everybody knows it has landed. Has no interest in the weather and very strong opinions about the bins.
dex.fact: Ring-necked parakeets have spread across London from birds that escaped or were released, and they now breed there in the wild.

species.real: Rose-ringed parakeets are native to a belt from West Africa to India, and they handle a British winter so well that some roosts in south-east England hold thousands of birds.
species.name: Squawkster

dex.text: Has claimed the bins, the bus shelter and the best bench in the park. Shouts its opinions across the rooftops, and nobody has yet won the argument.
dex.fact: Male ring-necked parakeets have a black and pink neck ring, which the females lack.
